label: Atmosphere, ocean and climate
text: EA.O.A4.3 Atmosphere, ocean and climate. Climate is the statistics of weather over a stated period, typically 30 years (WMO). Its state, circulation and change as a dated Earth claim are owned here. Controls are latitude, altitude, continentality, ocean currents and circulation. The governing laws (Navier–Stokes, radiative transfer, thermodynamics) are PH. Ocean circulation, sea level and marine biogeochemical state are owned here; marine biology is BI.O.A5. Köppen–Geiger is a classification (W12), not a mechanism. Climate change attribution claims owe W2 and W5. Atmospheric electricity and the upper atmosphere are refused to PH (space physics).

warrant.standard: Homogenised records with uncertainty; model ensembles with stated spread; detection and attribution
warrant.defeaters: Inhomogeneous records; model structural error; internal variability
